elements.details: Screenshot of Python code and output demonstrating the use of DataFrame.iloc[] for selection by row and column indices. The first code snippet selects all values in the second column (data.iloc[:, 2]) and shows output with indices and years (e.g., 0 2009, 1 2019, ..., 965 2017). The second code snippet selects all values in the third row (data.iloc[2, :]) and shows output with column labels and values (e.g., Title Titanic, Year 1997, Genre Drama, Rating 7.9, Duration 194).
elements.summary: This visual element shows Python code examples and their outputs to illustrate how to use DataFrame.iloc[] for selecting data by row and column indices in a DataFrame.
